prompts.title: Form: Recent Wins, Draws and Losses
prompts.prompt: 9:16 vertical composition. Permanent yellow subtitle band in the lower quarter, with safe margins. Editorial variant first: kinetic typography only, no axes. Background charcoal #101412. Large Spanish headline FORMA RECIENTE in warm white #edf0e6, then three stacked typographic rows: VICTORIAS, EMPATES, DERROTAS. For Valencia CF row, numbers appear as {{home.wins}}, {{home.draws}}, {{home.losses}} in lime #c5ed74, slate #8ca6bf, and warm white respectively. For Athletic Club, {{away.wins}}, {{away.draws}}, {{away.losses}} slide in from the opposite side. Rhythmic emphasis: each number punches in on a distinct beat, scale overshoot then settle. A thin lime underline travels beneath the active row. Camera slowly pushes in on the Valencia numbers, then racks to Athletic. Transition: horizontal wipe with charcoal panel. Exit: numbers collapse into a single lime dot at centre. Statistical variant: grouped count bars, shared zero baseline, Spanish category labels Victorias, Empates, Derrotas. Two bars per category: Valencia CF bar in lime, Athletic Club bar in slate. Y-axis unit chip resolved by renderer; no hardcoded units. Sample annotation at top right: Muestra reciente with {{home.n}} and {{away.n}} as separate sample markers. Source line at bottom above subtitles: Fuente: Bzzoiro. Entry animation: baseline draws left to right, then bars grow upward together. Main comparison: within each category, Valencia and Athletic bars align. Emphasis: the tallest bar per category gets a warm white halo, but no editorial judgement. Camera: locked wide, slight vertical drift. Transition: dissolve to next scene. Exit: bars flatten into baseline. Identify unequal samples: if sample markers differ, a small slate bracket highlights the difference. All labels Spanish, legible at mobile scale. Duration 8 seconds.

prompts.title: Goals: For and Against, Both Teams
prompts.prompt: 9:16 vertical. Permanent yellow subtitle band in lower quarter. Editorial variant: a stylised football pitch drawn in thin slate #8ca6bf lines on charcoal #101412, viewed top-down. Valencia CF and Athletic Club named in Spanish with warm white #edf0e6 lettering. A lime #c5ed74 ball travels along an animated path from midfield toward each goal, splitting into two arcs: one toward the Valencia goal, one toward the Athletic goal. The arcs end in abstract net-shake glyphs but show no numbers, no axes, no sample claims. Emphasis: the ball path pulses on the beat, then slows. Camera: slow parallax rise, pitch tilts slightly. Transition: pitch lines dissolve into statistical grid. Exit: ball shrinks to a point. Statistical variant: paired horizontal bars for goals for and against, both teams on a shared scale. Categories in Spanish: Goles a favor and Goles en contra. For Valencia CF, bars reference {{home.gf}} and {{home.ga}}; for Athletic Club, {{away.gf}} and {{away.ga}}. Bars use lime for goals for, slate for goals conceded. Common zero baseline, unit chip resolved by renderer, no hardcoded units. Sample annotation: Muestra reciente with {{home.n}} and {{away.n}} as separate markers. Source: Fuente: Bzzoiro above subtitles. Entry: axis draws, then four bars grow in staggered pairs. Main comparison: goals for versus goals against per team, then cross-team alignment. Emphasis: the larger conceded count gets a brief warm white outline. Camera: locked, gentle push on the cross-team gap. Transition: wipe to next scene. Exit: bars retract into baseline. Labels Spanish, legible. Duration 9 seconds.

prompts.title: Clean Sheets: Counts and Sample Sizes
prompts.prompt: 9:16 vertical. Permanent yellow subtitle band in lower quarter. Editorial variant: defensive energy and a stylised shield. Charcoal #101412 background, a large shield outline in slate #8ca6bf, with lime #c5ed74 energy lines converging on its centre. Valencia CF shield on the left half, Athletic Club shield on the right half, Spanish names in warm white #edf0e6. No numbers, no axes, no sample claims. Motion: shield lines vibrate like a held breath, then lock. A lime pulse travels around each shield rim. Camera: slow push through the shield centre. Transition: shield halves separate to reveal statistical layout. Exit: shields close into a single warm white line. Statistical variant: compare clean sheet counts and sample sizes without converting counts into rates. Two large count markers or vertical bars, one per team. Valencia CF bar references {{home.clean}}, Athletic Club bar references {{away.clean}}. Spanish heading Arcos en cero. Shared zero baseline, common count scale, unit chip resolved by renderer. Sample annotation: Muestra reciente with {{home.n}} and {{away.n}} as separate markers beside each bar. Source: Fuente: Bzzoiro above subtitles. Entry: baseline draws, then bars rise with a slight overshoot. Main comparison: side-by-side counts with matching count scale. Emphasis: the taller bar gets a lime underline, but no rate conversion and no editorial claim. Camera: locked, micro pan between bars. Transition: dissolve to next scene. Exit: bars fade into charcoal. All labels Spanish, mobile-legible. Typography uses warm white for headings and slate for secondary annotations. The lower quarter remains clear for yellow subtitles. Duration 7 seconds.

prompts.title: Head-to-Head: Historical Wins and Draws
prompts.prompt: 9:16 vertical. Permanent yellow subtitle band in lower quarter. Editorial variant: present both teams as a visual duel. Charcoal #101412 field, split diagonally. Valencia CF side in lime #c5ed74, Athletic Club side in slate #8ca6bf, Spanish names in warm white #edf0e6. Two abstract crests face each other; a warm white line of tension runs between them. No numbers, no axes, no sample claims, no forecast. Motion: crests slide in from opposite edges, clash, then hold. Lime and slate particles exchange sides. Camera: rapid push then hold on the centre line. Transition: centre line snaps open into statistical panel. Exit: crests fade to outline. Statistical variant: compare available historical win and draw counts, with total sample. Spanish labels Victorias Valencia CF, Victorias Athletic Club, Empates. Count bars share a zero baseline and a common count scale. Reference values: {{h2h.homeWins}}, {{h2h.awayWins}}, {{h2h.draws}}. Total sample annotation: Cruces previos with {{h2h.total}} as the sample size. Source: Fuente: Bzzoiro above subtitles. Explicit on-screen note in Spanish: Datos históricos, no una predicción. Entry: axis draws, bars grow together. Main comparison: Valencia historical wins vs Athletic historical wins, with draws as a third bar. Emphasis: the largest historical win count gets a warm white cap. Camera: locked, slight tilt to show draw bar. Transition: wipe to next scene. Exit: bars collapse to baseline. Historical data is not a forecast. Labels Spanish, legible. Duration 9 seconds.

prompts.title: Synthesis: Defeats and Clean Sheets Tension
prompts.prompt: 9:16 vertical. Permanent yellow subtitle band in lower quarter. Editorial variant: team reveals and narrative emphasis. Charcoal #101412 background. Valencia CF reveal first: warm white #edf0e6 typography spells VALENCIA CF, then cracks into slate #8ca6bf shards. Athletic Club reveal second: lime #c5ed74 typography spells ATHLETIC CLUB, then locks into a solid block. No numbers, no axes, no sample claims, no invented match events. Motion: rhythmic reveals on alternating beats; a thin warm white line traces a tension axis between the two team blocks. Camera: slow orbit from left to right. Transition: shards and block dissolve into a single statistical chart. Exit: both team names shrink into a corner tag. Statistical variant: one grounded statistical tension: defeats versus clean sheets, both counts in the same unit. Grouped horizontal bars per team. Spanish labels Derrotas and Arcos en cero. Valencia CF references {{home.losses}} and {{home.clean}}; Athletic Club references {{away.losses}} and {{away.clean}}. Shared zero baseline, common count scale, unit chip resolved by renderer. Sample annotation: Muestra reciente with {{home.n}} and {{away.n}} as separate sample markers. Source: Fuente: Bzzoiro above subtitles. The catalog contains no published model estimates, so only historical counts appear; no estimate is implied. Entry: axis draws, then bars grow in paired sequence. Main comparison: Athletic clean sheets versus Athletic defeats, against Valencia clean sheets and defeats. Emphasis: the widest gap between defeat count and clean sheet count receives a warm white bracket. Camera: locked, slight vertical drift. Transition: dissolve to next scene. Exit: brackets fade, bars retract. All labels Spanish, mobile-legible. Duration 10 seconds.
